claims.kickoff_quote: For each track in this wave, name the lane skill that owns its surface in the track's brief and have the implementer use it — python-pro / fastapi-expert / django-expert / postgres-pro / api-designer for backend work, ... Pick from the plugins we actually enabled; a track with no matching lane just uses the core skills.
claims.skill_quote: description: Use when optimizing PostgreSQL queries, configuring replication, or implementing advanced database features. Invoke for EXPLAIN analysis, JSONB operations, extension usage, VACUUM tuning, performance monitoring.
claims.reasoning: The only KICKOFF reference to postgres-pro is a bare name inside a lane-routing table that tells the orchestrator which skill to assign to which track surface. Routing/assignment across skills is the invocation's argument, not skill methodology — the skill's own frontmatter description is a trigger condition for self-selection, which is a different mechanism from an orchestrator naming it in a track brief. Nothing about EXPLAIN, indexes, JSONB, replication or VACUUM is restated in KICKOFF.
